title: Planned live demo at Electrostatic Society of America conference

tellings.quote: my lab is um that's in Cocoa Beach Florida and I will do a live demo of this.

plain: A NASA engineer named Charles Buhler says he will give a live demonstration of his propulsion device, which the episode presents as a form of antigravity, at a conference of the Electrostatic Society of America, a professional group for researchers who study static electricity. He tells Michels his lab is in Cocoa Beach, Florida, and that he will show it working there in person. If it works as he says, it would be a public demonstration of a new way to move things without ordinary thrust.
